integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the reflection criterion and Proposition 3.2. The proof independently reconstructs the perpendicular-bisector Gram matrix of a regular simplex and derives an exact identity rather than inferring it from numerical experiments. The bundled exact-rational checker is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes that the Morley simplex is exactly regular and controls one candidate transposition at a time. It gives weighted row stability and does not provide an unweighted row estimate without additional lower bounds on the scale parameters. It does not resolve the open reflection conjectures in dimensions four and five.
title: Exact quadratic stability identity for Morley reflection defects
